4
Yesu sɔhwɛ
(Marko 1.12-13; Luka 4.1-13)
1 # Heb 4.15 Ɛnna Honhom no de Yesu kɔɔ serɛ so sɛ ɔbonsam nkɔsɔ no nhwɛ. 2#Eks 34.28; 1 Ah 19.8 Na ɔdii mmuada adaduanan awia ne anadwo no, akyire yi no, ɛkɔm dee no. 3#Gye 3.1-7 Na ɔsɔhwɛfoɔ no baa ne nkyɛn bɛsee no sɛ: Sɛ wone Nyankopɔn Ba no a, kasa na aboɔ yi nnane paanoo. 4#Deut 8.3 Na ɔbuaa sɛ: Wɔatwerɛ sɛ:
Ɛnyɛ paanoo nko na onipa nam so bɛtena aseɛ,
na mmom asɛm biara a ɛfiri Nyankopɔn anomu ba no so.
5 # Mat 27.53 Ɛnna ɔbonsam de no kɔɔ kuro kronkron no mu, na ɔde no kɔgyinaa asɔrefie no atifi, 6#Dwom 91.11-12 na ɔsee no sɛ: Sɛ wone Nyankopɔn ba no a, to wo ho twene fam; na wɔatwerɛ sɛ:
Wo nti, ɔbɛhyɛ n’abɔfoɔ,
na wɔabɛsoa wo wɔn nsam,
na woamfa wo nan ampem boɔ.
7 # Deut 6.16 Yesu see no sɛ: Wɔatwerɛ bio sɛ: Nsɔ Awurade, wo Nyankopɔn, nhwɛ! 8Na ɔbonsam faa no bio kɔɔ bepɔ tenteenten bi so, na ɔkyerɛɛ no wiase ahennie nyinaa ne emu animuonyam, 9na ɔsee no sɛ: Sɛ wobɛkoto asɔre me a, anka mede yeinom nyinaa bɛma wo. 10#Deut 6.13 Ɛnna Yesu see no sɛ: Firi hɔ, Satan! na wɔatwerɛ sɛ:
Koto sɔre Awurade, wo Nyankopɔn,
na ɔno nko ara na som no.
11C Ɛnna ɔbonsam gyaa no hɔ, na hwɛ, abɔfoɔ ba bɛsomm no.
Yesu kɔ Galilea
(Marko 1.14-15; Luka 4.14-15)
12 # Mat 14.3 Na Yesu tee sɛ wɔakyere Yohane no, ɔsii mu kɔɔ Galilea. 13Na ɔfirii Nasaret kɔtenaa Kapernaum a ɛwɔ mpoano, Sebulon ne Naftali ahyeɛ so, 14#Yes 9.1-2 na deɛ Odiyifoɔ Yesaia kaeɛ no aba mu sɛ:
15Sebulon asase ne Naftali asase,
ɛpo kwan so, Yordan agya, amanaman Galilea,
16ɔman a wɔte sum mu no
hunuu hann kɛseɛ bi
na wɔn a wɔte owuo asase soɔ ne ne sunsum mu no,
hann bi apue ama wɔn.
17 # Mat 3.2 Ɛfiri saa berɛ no, Yesu firii aseɛ kaa asɛm sɛ: Monsakyera mo adwene; na ɔsoro ahennie no abɛn.
Asuafoɔ baanan bi frɛ
(Marko 1.16-20; Luka 5.1-11)
18Na Yesu nenam Galilea po ho no, ɔhunuu anuanom baanu, Simon a wɔfrɛ no Petro ne ne nua Andrea, sɛ wɔregu asau ɛpo no mu; na wɔyɛ apofofoɔ. 19#Mat 13.47; Hes 47.10 Na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Mommɛdi m’akyi, na mɛma moayɛ nnipa yifoɔ. 20#Mat 19.27 Na ntɛm ara wɔgyaa wɔn asau no hɔ, bɛdii n’akyi. 21Na ɔfiri hɔ kɔɔ n’anim no, ɔhunuu anuanom baanu bio, Sebedeo ba Yakobo ne ne nua Yohane, sɛ wɔne wɔn agya Sebedeo te kodoɔ mu repempam wɔn asau; na ɔfrɛɛ wɔn. 22Na ntɛm ara wɔgyaa kodoɔ no ne wɔn agya hɔ bɛdii n’akyi.
Galilea asɛnka ne ayaresa
23 # Mar 1.39; Luk 4.15; 4.44; Aso 10.38 Na Yesu kyinii Galilea nyinaa, kyerɛkyerɛe wɔn hyia adan mu, na ɔkaa ahennie no ho asɛmpa no, na ɔsaa yadeɛ ne ahoɔmmerɛ biara ɔman no mu. 24#Mar 6.55 Na ne ho asɛm trɛ kɔɔ Siria nyinaa, na wɔde wɔn a wɔyareɛ nyinaa, a nyarewa ne ɔhaw ahodoɔ akuta wɔn, wɔn a ahonhommɔne wɔ wɔn soɔ, wɔn a wɔyare ɛtwirɛ ne wɔn a wɔyare mmubuo brɛɛ no na ɔsaa wɔn yadeɛ. 25#Mar 3.7-8; Luk 6.17-19 Na nkurɔfoɔ akuakuo pii a wɔfiri Galilea ne Dekapoli ne Yerusalem ne Yuda ne Yordan agya dii n’akyi.

Ɛnna Honhom no de Yesu kɔɔ serɛ so sɛ ɔbonsam nkɔsɔ no nhwɛ. Na ɔdii mmuada adaduanan awia ne anadwo no, akyire yi no, ɛkɔm dee no. Na ɔsɔhwɛfoɔ no baa ne nkyɛn bɛsee no sɛ: Sɛ wone Nyankopɔn Ba no a, kasa na aboɔ yi nnane paanoo. Na ɔbuaa sɛ: Wɔatwerɛ sɛ:
Ɛnyɛ paanoo nko na onipa nam so bɛtena aseɛ,
na mmom asɛm biara a ɛfiri Nyankopɔn anomu ba no so.
Ɛnna ɔbonsam de no kɔɔ kuro kronkron no mu, na ɔde no kɔgyinaa asɔrefie no atifi, na ɔsee no sɛ: Sɛ wone Nyankopɔn ba no a, to wo ho twene fam; na wɔatwerɛ sɛ:
Wo nti, ɔbɛhyɛ n’abɔfoɔ,
na wɔabɛsoa wo wɔn nsam,
na woamfa wo nan ampem boɔ.
Yesu see no sɛ: Wɔatwerɛ bio sɛ: Nsɔ Awurade, wo Nyankopɔn, nhwɛ! Na ɔbonsam faa no bio kɔɔ bepɔ tenteenten bi so, na ɔkyerɛɛ no wiase ahennie nyinaa ne emu animuonyam, na ɔsee no sɛ: Sɛ wobɛkoto asɔre me a, anka mede yeinom nyinaa bɛma wo. Ɛnna Yesu see no sɛ: Firi hɔ, Satan! na wɔatwerɛ sɛ:
Koto sɔre Awurade, wo Nyankopɔn,
na ɔno nko ara na som no.
C Ɛnna ɔbonsam gyaa no hɔ, na hwɛ, abɔfoɔ ba bɛsomm no.


Na Yesu tee sɛ wɔakyere Yohane no, ɔsii mu kɔɔ Galilea. Na ɔfirii Nasaret kɔtenaa Kapernaum a ɛwɔ mpoano, Sebulon ne Naftali ahyeɛ so, na deɛ Odiyifoɔ Yesaia kaeɛ no aba mu sɛ:
Sebulon asase ne Naftali asase,
ɛpo kwan so, Yordan agya, amanaman Galilea,
ɔman a wɔte sum mu no
hunuu hann kɛseɛ bi
na wɔn a wɔte owuo asase soɔ ne ne sunsum mu no,
hann bi apue ama wɔn.
Ɛfiri saa berɛ no, Yesu firii aseɛ kaa asɛm sɛ: Monsakyera mo adwene; na ɔsoro ahennie no abɛn.


Na Yesu nenam Galilea po ho no, ɔhunuu anuanom baanu, Simon a wɔfrɛ no Petro ne ne nua Andrea, sɛ wɔregu asau ɛpo no mu; na wɔyɛ apofofoɔ. Na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Mommɛdi m’akyi, na mɛma moayɛ nnipa yifoɔ. Na ntɛm ara wɔgyaa wɔn asau no hɔ, bɛdii n’akyi. Na ɔfiri hɔ kɔɔ n’anim no, ɔhunuu anuanom baanu bio, Sebedeo ba Yakobo ne ne nua Yohane, sɛ wɔne wɔn agya Sebedeo te kodoɔ mu repempam wɔn asau; na ɔfrɛɛ wɔn. Na ntɛm ara wɔgyaa kodoɔ no ne wɔn agya hɔ bɛdii n’akyi.

Na Yesu kyinii Galilea nyinaa, kyerɛkyerɛe wɔn hyia adan mu, na ɔkaa ahennie no ho asɛmpa no, na ɔsaa yadeɛ ne ahoɔmmerɛ biara ɔman no mu. Na ne ho asɛm trɛ kɔɔ Siria nyinaa, na wɔde wɔn a wɔyareɛ nyinaa, a nyarewa ne ɔhaw ahodoɔ akuta wɔn, wɔn a ahonhommɔne wɔ wɔn soɔ, wɔn a wɔyare ɛtwirɛ ne wɔn a wɔyare mmubuo brɛɛ no na ɔsaa wɔn yadeɛ. Na nkurɔfoɔ akuakuo pii a wɔfiri Galilea ne Dekapoli ne Yerusalem ne Yuda ne Yordan agya dii n’akyi.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
